title: Russian strike on Kyiv’s science academy kills at least one in latest daytime attack
summary_full: Three others wounded as jet-powered drones increasingly target Ukraine’s capital, with medical centre also hitEurope live – latest updatesA Russian drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, killing at least one person, in the latest daytime attack on Ukraine’s capital.Flames tore through the historic building as people clambered out of first- and second-floor windows to escape, in dramatic scenes increasingly familiar in the heavily bombarded city.
